## Modules

- [Nvir](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.md): This is the main API for Nvir, an environment variable loader and validator.
- [Nvir.Cast](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.Cast.md): Collection of casters for environment variables.

- [Nvir.Parser](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.Parser.md): A behaviour for environment variables sources parser.
- [Nvir.Parser.DefaultParser](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.Parser.DefaultParser.md): The default parser implementation for dotenv files.

- Exceptions
  - [Nvir.CastError](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.CastError.md): Exception defining an invalid cast. For instance with this dotenv file
  - [Nvir.LoadError](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.LoadError.md): Exception raised when `Nvir.dotenv!/1` fails to parse a dotenv file.

  - [Nvir.Parser.ParseError](https://nvir.hexdocs.pm/Nvir.Parser.ParseError.md): Exception representing parse errors from the default parser `Nvir.Parser`.
